verdict.rationale: Direct probes found no agent-oriented documentation: https://proton.me/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and so did the markdown docs endpoint https://proton.me/support/pass.md. The documented Proton Pass CLI is a scripting and CI/CD tool, not llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so it earns no credit for this story.
